title: Design differences between the open_ended_code and galaxy arms (archived Galaxy_benchmark runs)
scope: 4,240 archived runs: BixBench50 1,500; CompBio 2,500; IWC 240. Read-only extraction; ground_truth/, evaluation.json and result.json contents, .env and credentials were not read; no agent code run; no server contacted.

conventions.run_key: benchmark + task + run_id (run_id is unique only within a task)
conventions.condition: 'galaxy' or 'open_ended_code' as labelled in history_analysis_evidence.json runs[].condition
conventions.model: model key as in BixBench50_CompBio_analysis/analysis.json runs[].model
conventions.redaction: The public Galaxy username that appears in BixBench seed-history records and one IWC run-root name is replaced by '[galaxy-user]'.
conventions.not_recorded: 'not recorded' means no field carrying the value was found in the archive; it is never imputed.

q2_model_runtime.note: IWC task evidence labels all 240 runs 'user_supplied_only', but each IWC run has codex_invocation.json runtime.model and model_reasoning_effort (the IWC README treats these as verification). GPT runs record no model-provider override (default provider). CompBio has no runtime model record for 900 open-ended GPT-5.5/Sol/Luna runs, 56 Galaxy GPT-5.5 runs and 30 Galaxy Sol runs. The campaign registry gives only descriptive settings ('high reasoning / fast processing' for GPT-5.5, Sol and Luna; Luna Galaxy campaign names contain 'luna_max_fast'). service_tier is 'fast' for GPT runs and empty for DeepSeek via Codex. q6_tools.note: A recorded list of exposed Galaxy MCP tools exists only for IWC (7 tools: stage_workspace_file, search_galaxy_tools, inspect_galaxy_history, inspect_archive_inventory, inspect_galaxy_tool, run_galaxy_tool_and_wait, wait_for_galaxy_jobs); it omits run_galaxy_udt_and_wait and no IWC run called it. BixBench and CompBio exposure lists are not recorded; Galaxy-arm prompts name run_galaxy_udt_and_wait (BixBench) or permit UDTs (CompBio), and Galaxy-arm traces call it. CompBio Galaxy traces also call peek_galaxy_dataset, which is absent from the IWC list. compbio_campaign_run_counts.source: run_record.json agent_workspace campaign directory per archived CompBio run

q7_campaign_selection.note: CompBio final vectors are composites. 'Largest campaign' is the campaign contributing most items to a vector; other campaigns include recoveries, continuations, completions, retries, repeats and fresh-history reruns. Campaign names containing 'wrong', 'wrongset', 'fastwrong', 'target84' or 'near84' (outcome_named) suggest item selection informed by earlier answers or scores; names containing 'consensus' or 'top10' indicate other selective reruns whose criterion is not stated. The selection rules are not recorded in the archive. Registry campaign names carry two account-like tokens that the archive redacts as [REDACTED ACCOUNT]; they are shown here as [account-A]/[account-B]. Cross-replicate counts compare the _rN token in the campaign name with the archived replicate label and are not computed for open-ended GPT-5.5, whose registry labels are offset (gpt55-anycode-jul30 = R1, gpt55-anycode-r1 = R2, gpt55-anycode-r2 = R3).
